notes: Rule-based compliance checks for FinDesk V6 (policy compliance analysis).

rules.description: Every invoice of Rs. 25,000 or more must carry a PO reference.
Every invoice must carry a vendor GSTIN (needed for input tax credit).
Invoices above Rs. 25,000 require a Goods Receipt Note before payment.
Reimbursement receipts are mandatory for expenses of Rs. 500 or more.
Reimbursement claims must be submitted within 30 days of the expense date.
